summary: A stretch limousine: the four-door saloon lengthened 1.75 m between the axles, with a long fixed privacy wind… joints door_fl, door_fr, door_rl, door_rr, wheel_f_l_roll, wheel_f_l_steer, …; options paint, trim_level; sockets eye_point, instrument_anchor, seat_driver, seat_pax_1, seat_pax_2, seat_pax_3, ….
